meta.note: CPU construction semantics only. No process, no NCCL, no all_to_all_v, no real checkpoint. Not a paper result.
meta.chain: AM-HighestAttnKeys: softmax-RMS select, box beta [-3,3] iters=2, OLS value

definitions.bind_rule: a key is on a bound when |beta_j - bound| <= bind_tol, in beta units
definitions.dead_rule: per retained key j: c_j = w_j * sum_i A_ij; c_j < DEAD_REL * sum_j c_j. The denominator is the sum over retained keys only, and A is the beta design matrix stacked over all n_ref calibration queries.
definitions.mass_residual_rule: ||A w - m||_2 / ||m||_2 where A and m are stacked over ALL n_ref calibration queries and the norm is taken once over the stacked vector; it is NOT a mean of per-query ratios
definitions.beta_design: A in R^(n_ref x t), A_ij = exp(q_i . C_k_j / sqrt(d)) after a per-row max shift; target m_i = sum over ALL source keys of exp(q_i . K / sqrt(d))
definitions.value_design: X in R^(n_ref x t), X_ij = softmax_j(q_i . C_k_j / sqrt(d) + beta_j); target Y = dense attention output on the same queries
definitions.payload: per edge: t*dk*dtype + t*dv*dtype (keys, values) + t*dtype (beta) + t*index_bytes (indices) + meta_bytes. No cross-edge total is defined.

solver_policy.note: CUDA torch.linalg.lstsq only supports driver='gels', which assumes full rank and does not return a usable rank. A GPU run must obtain rank/cond from a separate diagnostic pass and record both. A failed solve is recorded as failed; switching to ridge/pinv is forbidden.
